items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: We had (UNINTELLIGIBLE), he and his wife. We had (Jackie Marlin?) he and his girlfriend were coming out there.

ctx.x: He became a loner. Didn't want to be bothered with anybody. He sent us a telegram when he found out Zutty was coming to Berkeley and he had everything arranged, he just wanted the three of us to be together, to hang out together. But Zutty had too many friends out there.
I had (UNINTELLIGIBLE), he and his wife. We had (Jackie Marlin?) he and his girlfriend were coming out there. And I just couldn't do it.
